# implement-spec ledger — P05.2 Curation UI and review queue
Base: devin/p05-1-probabilistic-er @ f7e6b421646ffe6abee77e493bc7d00d484738d9
Branch: devin/p05-2-curation-ui

## Requirement IDs
SIG-IDENT-025 (confidence explanation surfaced), SIG-IDENT-026 (LLM review rationale, no graph write, model/prompt logged per decision),
SIG-LLM-001 (permitted uses), SIG-LLM-002 (prohibited uses / only-to-queue), SIG-LLM-003 (record model_id/prompt_version/params + schema-validate),
SIG-LLM-004 + SIG-PARSE-003 (source span; span absent from capture rejected), SIG-LLM-005 (R6 + PROPOSED), SIG-LLM-006 (per-type sampling + gold accuracy + demote-to-human-only), SIG-LLM-007 (graceful degradation).

## Design
- No new package. parsing/ = LLM extraction scaffolding + span guardrail. resolution/ = review queue + curation CLI (forward dep on parsing).
- Curation UI = plain CLI + JSONL file-backed queue (web/ deferred to P15). Deviation -> ADR-030.

docs/adr/ADR-030-*.md, docs/traceability.md, docs/risk_register.md
tests/parsing/test_extraction.py, tests/parsing/test_cli_extraction.py, tests/resolution/test_review_queue.py, tests/resolution/test_cli_review.py
